{{samename|[[e-Reader]] application|Gotcha! (e-Reader)}} [[File:GOTCHA.png|thumb|{{ga|Gloria}} and [[Gigantamax]] {{p|Cinderace}}]] '''GOTCHA!''' (Japanese: '''GOTCHA!''') is a special {{pkmn|animation|animated}} music video that was first released as part of a video about the [[Pokémon Sword and Shield Expansion Pass]] on the [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BoZ0Zwab6Oc official YouTube channel] on September 29, 2020. It features the song [[Acacia]] by the Japanese rock band {{wp|Bump of Chicken|BUMP OF CHICKEN}}, including captions in nine languages. ==Plot== [[File:GOTCHA first partner Pokémon.png|thumb|All the [[first partner Pokémon]] up to [[Generation VII]]]] The video begins on the Pokémon logo, which fades into four featureless characters resembling the protagonists of the film ''{{wp|Stand by Me (film)|Stand by Me}}'' walking along a railroad, a reference to the film which played on the [[television]] in the [[Generation I]] games. It then cuts to images of a young boy growing up with his {{p|Pikachu}}, before waking up to have the Pikachu crawling over his face; similarly, a young girl is shown growing up with her {{p|Eevee}}, waking up in the morning to give it a kiss on the cheek. The boy, his Pikachu on his head, walks out in front of a third person, sleeping in front of a film projector with her {{p|Yamper}}, and the camera zooms into the sky-like setting on his shirt, where the girl is shown skipping while wearing a backpack with her Eevee in it. The boy and girl each walk through their various locales while in the background, all of the [[Gym Leader]]s, [[Trial Captain]]s, [[island kahuna]]s, and [[Elite Four]] members from the first seven [[generation]]s watch them, gathered amongst themselves by their common [[type]]s. As they continue walking, the boy and the girl lose each of their Pokémon. Separately, the boy and girl find themselves in a modern-looking city, where they see silhouettes of various [[Legendary Pokémon]], [[Mythical Pokémon]], and [[Ultra Beast]]s, followed by the silhouettes of the main antagonists of the first seven generations of core games. The boy and girl then each find the other's Pokémon. As the boy looks at the girl's Eevee, the various [[player characters]] are shown running happily together in silhouette, with {{ga|Calem}} stopping to look at the audience. The scene cuts to various moments from the games. The [[Pokémon Champion]]s — [[Lance]] with his {{TP|Lance|Dragonite}}, {{Steven}} Mega Evolving his {{TP|Steven|Metagross}}, [[Wallace]] with his {{p|Milotic}}, [[Cynthia]] with her {{TP|Cynthia|Garchomp}}, [[Alder]] and [[Iris]] high-fiving each other, and [[Diantha]] with a [[Poké Ball]] — appear for the camera; {{ga|Rosa}} and [[Hugh]] get ready for a battle with {{ga|Lucas}} and {{ga|Barry}}; [[Shauna]], [[Tierno]], and [[Trevor]] smile; {{ga|Hilda}} is shown walking with [[Cheren]] and [[Bianca]], before being replaced by {{ga|Nate}} and the older versions of Cheren and Bianca, respectively; {{ga|Serena}} and her {{p|Greninja}} get into a [[battle]] with {{p|Mewtwo}}; {{ga|Elio}} is shown alongside [[Hau]] and [[Gladion]]; similarly, {{ga|Selene}} is shown with [[Lillie]] and [[Nebby]] (as a {{p|Cosmog}}); [[N]] with his {{p|Reshiram}} stares at {{ga|Hilbert}} and Hilda with their {{p|Zekrom}}; {{ga|Lyra}} is shown similarly staring at {{ga|Silver}} and the three [[Johto first partner Pokémon]] ({{p|Meganium}}, {{p|Typhlosion}}, and {{p|Feraligatr}}); [[Wally]] confronts {{ga|Brendan}} and {{ga|May}}; {{ga|Blue}} stands at the gate of the [[Pokémon League]] with all of his Pokémon; and {{ga|Ethan}} is shown atop [[Mt. Silver]] locked in a fierce battle with {{ga|Red}}. As it begins [[rain]]ing, Red's cap flies off and lands on the boy's Pikachu (who is now being carried around by the girl) as a silhouette of {{p|Kyogre}} passes by; similarly, the boy stares at the girl's Eevee during [[harsh sunlight]] while being silhouetted by {{p|Groudon}}. The sky eventually clears, and the boy and girl continue walking around. The scene cuts to the various [[Galar]] Gym Leaders and participants in the Champion Cup. As [[Hop]] gets ready for battle, he "transforms" into [[Leon]], who is then shown in his battle with {{ga|Victor}} and {{ga|Gloria}}. After being defeated, Leon throws his cap in the air, which flies through a marquee screen and onto the boy and the Eevee. Looking up, they see the girl and the Pikachu, and they reunite as {{p|Zacian}} and {{p|Zamazenta}} are shown sleeping together in the marquee screen. As the boy and girl speak to each other, they are watched over by the various {{pkmn|professor}}s, and then by all of the [[region]]al [[first partner Pokémon]], in the marquee screen. The boy and girl, wearing Red and Leon's hats respectively, then leave with their respective Pokémon, while the {{tc|Subway Boss}}es and {{tc|Battle Chatelaine}}s appear and pose on two nearby billboards. The scene then transitions back to the four boys from the beginning. The camera tilts up to show {{p|Mew}} flying overhead; after it briefly looks at the camera, a silhouetted man waves to the camera and throws a [[Poké Ball]] at it as the title appears. After that, the credits roll on a cinema screen with a sleeping girl and her Yamper sitting in the seats as the only audience members. ==Characters== ===Humans===
